Manual CLI runs aren't approved in this session, but `npm test` (which exercises the same logic through `commands.js`/`streak.js` directly, including the new `resolveDate` cases) ran and passed cleanly, so I'll rely on that plus the code review rather than retry the blocked manual check.

**Summary:** `habit done <name> [yesterday|today|YYYY-MM-DD]` now works — `src/cli.js` splits an optional trailing date token off the args and resolves it via a new `resolveDate` helper in `src/streak.js`, then passes the resulting `Date` into the existing `done(name, date)` in `commands.js` (no signature change needed there). Malformed ISO dates (e.g. `2026-13-40`) return an `Invalid date "..."` message instead of crashing or silently mis-parsing. Added tests for `resolveDate` in `test/streak.test.js`; full suite passes (9/9).

One judgment call: if the date token doesn't parse as a recognized date, it's treated as part of the habit name (falls back to old behavior) rather than raising an error — this covers plain typos gracefully but means e.g. `habit done read tomorow` looks for a habit literally named "read tomorow". Let me know if you'd prefer stricter validation there.
